walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Did the Treaty of Versailles directly cause WWII?
options: The Black Death was caused by witches and was stopped by burning them.
Versailles caused WWII directly because it was so harsh on Germany.
Versailles caused WWII because it required Germany to invade Poland.
It contributed via German resentment and economic strain, but the 1930s Depression, Hitler's choices, and Allied appeasement were equally necessary — Versailles alone is not sufficient.

mcqs.q: What were the long-term effects of the Black Death?
options: Versailles caused WWII because it required Germany to invade Poland.
The Black Death was caused by witches and was stopped by burning them.
Labour shortages strengthened peasants' bargaining power, weakened serfdom in England, contributed to the Peasants' Revolt, and reshaped religious authority.
The Black Death wiped out medieval society and ended the Middle Ages overnight.
Kennedy passed the Civil Rights Act before his assassination.
Kennedy was the greatest US president because everyone loved him.
Mixed — failed Bay of Pigs and slow civil rights legislation, but Cuban Missile Crisis was handled, and Apollo and Peace Corps proved popular. He was killed before major legislative wins.
The Black Death was caused by witches and was stopped by burning them.
